newsitem.title: FRANCE: Most French voters oppose early election.
newsitem.headline: Most French voters oppose early election.

text.p: Two thirds of French voters oppose an early election and would prefer the poll to be held on schedule next March, an opinion poll said on Saturday.
The Ipsos survey to be published on Sunday in the weekly Journal du Dimanche said 23 percent of 940 people questioned wanted the poll brought forward while 65 percent did not.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe has dismissed speculation that President Jacques Chirac might bring forward the election in a bid to secure a conservative majority for the rest of his seven-year term.

Of those polled, 40 percent said they wanted Gaullist Juppe and his centre-right cabinet dismissed before next year's election. One third wanted Juppe to stay on with his cabinet unchanged, and 21 percent wanted Juppe to stay and reshuffle his cabinet.
